annotations.title: Turn off auto-reorder for an item

description: Stop watching one item: it will no longer be suggested for reordering however low it runs. Its thresholds are forgotten, so turning it back on means setting them again. Suggestions already produced for this item are not withdrawn — cancel those orders separately if the merchant wants them gone.
name: hub_remove_reorder_rule
title: Turn off auto-reorder for an item
